scope: Source research and synthetic tooling checks; no new original-game execution

sources.title: callumjenkins/pc-saturnbomberman/README.md
sources.finding: Exact-game AI-assisted static recompilation lead; upstream author describes Claude Code use and known divergence.

sources.title: callumjenkins/pc-saturnbomberman/decomp/krnl.c
sources.finding: Nine candidate kernel functions; direction-mask helper is suitable for a bounded original-byte experiment.

sources.title: callumjenkins/pc-saturnbomberman/decomp/check.py
sources.finding: Randomized interpreter comparison, not independent hardware proof; zero/negative trials and unknown names can yield false success; VDP1 register range is modelled as RAM.

sources.title: callumjenkins/pc-saturnbomberman/src/bomberman/lab.py
sources.finding: sheet combines screenshots; verify/memory/writes expose useful comparison mechanisms with declared constraints.

sources.title: callumjenkins/pc-saturnbomberman/src/bomberman/routes.py
sources.finding: normal/single are input-only starting routes; wide battle requests multitap and other routes inject writes/hooks.

sources.title: callumjenkins/pc-saturnbomberman/game.toml
sources.finding: USA symbols and inventory source ranges; selected build explicitly enables optional GPL VDP1 renderer.

sources.title: callumjenkins/saturn-recomp/src/saturnrecomp/sh2emu.py
sources.finding: Bounded isolated SH-2 CPU interpreter; flat memory lacks full Saturn hardware behaviour.

sources.title: callumjenkins/saturn-recomp/THIRD_PARTY.md
sources.finding: Component notices and optional renderer build implications; preserve separation from Neptune runtime.

sources.title: ymir-emu/Ymir/README.md
sources.finding: Current Linux-capable emulator/debugging candidate; not yet executed on Neptune originals.

sources.title: ymir-emu/Ymir/libs/ymir-core/include/ymir/debug/sh2_tracer_base.hpp
sources.finding: Explicit ISH2Tracer interface; concrete integration point for bounded instruction/memory observations.

sources.title: ymir-emu/Ymir/libs/ymir-core/include/ymir/sys/saturn.hpp
sources.finding: RunFrame, debug-tracing and per-component tracer APIs; potential headless research adapter.

sources.title: FCare/Kronos/yabause/src/port/qt/ui/UIDebugVDP1.cpp
sources.finding: Actual Vdp1DebugRawTexture and bitmap save paths exist; test export rather than rebuilding a decoder first.

sources.title: Yabause Qt debugger documentation
sources.finding: VDP1 texture export and VDP2 tilemap viewer; GUI capabilities are not a headless API.

sources.title: Sega VDP1 User's Manual
sources.finding: Primary hardware description for commands, pixels and end-code rules; archived original publication.

sources.title: Sega VDP1 supplement
sources.finding: Use with main VDP1 manual when resolving implementation details.

sources.title: Sega VDP2 User's Manual
sources.finding: Sprite-type palette interpretation and display composition must accompany texture extraction.

sources.title: Sega SCSP User's Manual
sources.finding: Preserve sample loop modes and register state; rendered WAV alone does not represent the instrument.

sources.title: Renesas SH-1/SH-2/SH-DSP Software Manual
sources.finding: Primary instruction semantics, including delayed branches; compare interpreters against documented behaviour.

sources.title: Mednafen debugger manual
sources.finding: Saturn CPU/memory debugger supports bounded dumps; warns about state/reset actions while stepping.

sources.title: Mednafen Saturn manual
sources.finding: Standalone Saturn settings and limitations; not automatically the same frontend/API as libretro.

sources.title: Beetle Saturn core documentation
sources.finding: Use existing accepted libretro reference; pin actual binary, settings and controller topology.

sources.title: VGKintsugi/Ghidra-SegaSaturn-Loader/README.md
sources.finding: ISO loader only loads first file; mirrors and save-state format limitations require explicit overlay/state import.

sources.title: Ghidra headless analysis
sources.finding: Supported deterministic import/scripts/timeouts are the baseline before adding agent adapters.

sources.title: LaurieWired/GhidraMCP/README.md
sources.finding: Headless PyGhidra path exists but documents Ghidra 12.1.4 and Python 3.10-3.13; pin a compatible stack.

sources.title: UnderminersTeam/UndertaleModTool/README.md
sources.finding: Linux CLI supported; VM code recovery is distinct from YYC; source build has its own .NET requirements.

sources.title: UnderminersTeam/UndertaleModTool/UndertaleModCli/Program.cs
sources.finding: Actual info and dump --sprites/--textures/--code options inspected; prefer fresh export directories.

sources.title: UnderminersTeam/UndertaleModTool/SCRIPTS.md
sources.finding: Separate exporters cover code, assembly, textures, sprites, masks, sounds, fonts and rooms; room PNG script is Windows GUI only.

sources.title: UnderminersTeam/Underanalyzer/README.md
sources.finding: VM analysis/compiler/decompiler library, not a YYC-native decompiler; API stability needs a pin.

sources.title: Power Bomberman developer release post
sources.finding: Developer still lists 0.7.8c (1 March 2026), platform clients and matching optional server; archive hashes remain to collect.

sources.title: Jyamarui mod author's instructions
sources.finding: Firsthand Power 0.7.7+ data.win/UTMT sprite replacement example, including embedded texture and menu icon dependencies.

sources.title: Saturn sprite ripper's catalogue
sources.finding: Author reports VRAM/memory editing and missing Normal-only Bomberman/Tirra animations; useful coverage gap, not proof of our output.

sources.title: Master-mode TAS authors' submission discussion
sources.finding: Firsthand collision, subpixel and held/thrown/kicked bomb timing leads. Search retrieved text; direct page fetch restricted.

sources.title: kingshriek SSF tools and notes
sources.finding: Driver-specific sound-memory/tone/sequence tools, false-positive and DSP cautions; must identify Bomberman's driver first.

sources.title: niekvlessert/ssfplay_tools/README.md
sources.finding: Headless SSF WAV/VGM and triggered-sample tools; active samples only, Mednafen lineage, padded WAV defaults.

sources.title: vgmtrans/vgmtrans/README.md
sources.finding: Sega sequence/instrument support is a candidate decoder after format identification, not universal driver support.

sources.title: FFmpeg Sega FILM demuxer
sources.finding: Recognizes FILM/FDSC/STAB and video/audio packets; prefer this route for Saturn CPK over unrelated CRI CPK tools.

sources.title: sonsegajp/SaturnRecomp/README.md
sources.finding: Additional toolkit lead explicitly says public playable path is interpreted, complete AOT emitter not present; defer adoption.

sources.title: ecruells/resident-evil-pc-decomp/README.md
sources.finding: Different-game prior art for native reconstruction and asset tooling; no evidence its formats equal Bomberman's.

sources.title: Ghidra current installation requirements
sources.finding: Current main documentation calls for JDK 25; do not mix it blindly with GhidraMCP's documented 12.1.4/Java 21 stack.
